class.name: IfcSensor
class.brief_description: A sensor is a device that measures a physical quantity and converts it into a signal which can be read by an observer or by an instrument. HISTORY New entity in IFC2x4 Type Use Definition IfcSensor defines the occurrence of any sensor; common information about sensor types is handled by IfcSensorType . The IfcSensorType (if present) may establish the common type name, usage (predefined type), prop
